## Workload

Elif Sahin completed grading work on 942 sets during 450 rostered hours. This represents an average workload of 2.1 sets per hour. The volume reviewed is consistent with the recorded allocation of grading time.

## Quality

A sample of 69 sets was read again as part of the quality review. The resulting agreement rate was 79.7 per cent. This provides a measure of consistency between the original grading and the subsequent review.

No further action is required on the basis of this review. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
